title: Which 3 Environments Are You Playing Solitaire In?
author: yonuel_interactive
selftext: I had fun generating concept art for my VR Solitaire game using Gemini and Copilot! I used Gemini to generate the image prompts. Then, I handed over the image prompt to Copilot, along with a screenshot of my game. One thing I noticed is Nano Banana does a really good job at consistency. Meanwhile, Copilot does a really good job at the stylized eye-catching look. This is a great starting point for me to solidify the art direction for my game. Anyway, here are the best results. Which 3 are you play in?

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body:
My 2 cents... For this sort of game I'm not sure that would be a central concern of mine. I'd be much more interested in new mechanics than in the scenery, but given super engaging mechanics then I guess the presentation could be a small nudge forward. I'd also value animation and dynamism on the UI, motion of cards, over a hand and background.

With that said, to me the hot air balloon is the more intriguing... Though a bit too warm and monochromatic in palette. It would be hard to stare at it for a long time, abd this tends to be a long game.

replies.author: yonuel_interactive
replies.body: Very valuable feedback, thank you! What type of mechanics do you envision to make the game more engaging?
